text:
Mina: Pushing a compact-host-list mock for the private setup prereq. Main goals: cleaner collapsed rows for many hosts, clearer failed-state copy, and keyboard-first focus order. Loom in thread. Priya: Nice! On narrow screens the host name wraps weirdly. can we move the time/last-run to the right and keep the hostname single line with ellipsis? Jae: Agree on single-line hostnames. Also think the status pill needs explicit copy changes: instead of 'Errored' use 'Network check failed' and show a short reason like 'SSH closed' when available. Oliver: Accessibility: pills should have aria-describedby linking to the short reason. Also role="button" for expandable row so keyboard users can hit Enter/Space. Mina: Good call. Proposed pill variants: green=Healthy, amber=Partial, red=Failed, gray=Unknown. For 'Unknown' use copy 'No response' not 'Unknown'. Priya: Microcopy nit: for partial results use 'Partial results some probes skipped' rather than technical jargon. keep it under ~35 chars. Jae: For collapsed rows add a tiny chevron icon with aria-hidden and the entire row as a focusable element. When expanded, focus moves to the first actionable button: 'Retry network probe'. Oliver: Focus order: row (expand) -> primary action (Retry) -> secondary (Show logs) -> link to help article. When closing the panel focus should return to the row. mention in spec. Mina: On mobile we collapse actions into a kebab menu. But question: should 'Show logs' open a full-screen drawer or push to a new page? I prefer drawer for context. Priya: Drawer is good. ensure escape and swipe down dismiss, and that the drawer has a clear heading 'Network logs for host foo.example.com'. Jae: Small code sample for screen reader announce: ```
Network check failed for foo.example.com: SSH timeout
``` Make sure we avoid duplicate speaks when the drawer loads logs. Oliver: Color contrast: current amber (#f2b66d) is ~3.3:1 with white text. Either darken to #d28a2b or use dark text. Prefer dark text for the pill to match brand. Mina: I'll update assets. Also adding a tiny hint line under collapsed host: 'Last probe: 2m ago 3 checks' to help triage quickly. Priya: UX question: Should 'Retry' be debounced per-host for autoscan bursts? PM suggested a 10s cooldown to avoid repeated retries. Jae: Yes debounce. Show the toast 'Retry queued Undo' for 6s. If user undoes, cancel request and return pill to previous state. Oliver: For aria labeling, use descriptive action labels like 'Retry network probe for foo.example.com' instead of generic 'Retry'. screen reader users appreciate context. Mina: I'll update Figma and the PR description to include keyboard flows, mobile drawer behavior, cooldown logic, and pill color updates. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new build uploaded: compact-host-list-prereq-ui at 2356789000 Priya: After PR lands, I'll run keyboard-only and VoiceOver checks. Key checklist: single-line hostnames, focus return on close, aria-describedby for reason, contrast>=4.5 for small text, and no double announcements. Jae: Also add unit tests for the cooldown debounce and an E2E test that retries and undoes successfully. Mina: Thanks team aiming for patch release next week. If anyone has urgent copy changes ping here.
